title: Global single-degree cancellation of finite polynomial coefficient obstructions
statement:
Let $D$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $D\to A$ a homomorphism of commutative rings, and $q:X\to\operatorname{Spec}D$ a separated finite type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Fix a finite affine open cover $X=\bigcup_{j=1}^r T_j$, $T_j=\operatorname{Spec}S_j$, and surjections $Q_j=D[x_1,\ldots,x_{s_j}]\twoheadrightarrow S_j$ with $s_j\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Put $X_A=X\times_D\operatorname{Spec}A$, with projection $\pi:X_A\to X$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X_A})$ [def-pc-derived-category], let $F\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have bounded coherent cohomology [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\gamma:F\to R\pi_*K$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. On $T_j$, let $L_j\in D(S_j)$ and $K_j\in D(S_j\otimes_D A)$ be the objects corresponding to $F|_{T_j}$ and $K|_{(T_j)_A}$ under [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence]. Let $\gamma_j:L_j\to\operatorname{Res}_{S_j}^{S_j\otimes_D A}K_j$ be the affine restriction of $\gamma$. Here $\operatorname{Res}$ denotes termwise restriction of scalars, and the affine derived pushforward is identified with it by [lem-pc-affine-pushforward-resolution-quasi-iso]. Put $Q_{j,A}=A[x_1,\ldots,x_{s_j}]$. In the module derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] define
$$C_j=\operatorname{Cone}\left(Q_{j,A}\otimes_{Q_j}^{\mathbf L}\operatorname{Res}_{Q_j}^{S_j}L_j\xrightarrow{1\otimes\gamma_j}Q_{j,A}\otimes_{Q_j}^{\mathbf L}\operatorname{Res}_{Q_j}^{S_j\otimes_D A}K_j\xrightarrow{\mu_j}\operatorname{Res}_{Q_{j,A}}^{S_j\otimes_D A}K_j\right).$$
Tensor is computed by K-flat resolutions [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]; $\mu_j$ is the extension--restriction counit induced by the given $A$-action. Cones have the meaning of [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Suppose $n\in\mathbf Z$, $H^i(C_j)=0$ for every $j$ and $i>n$, and $H^n(C_j)$ is a finitely generated $Q_{j,A}$-module for every $j$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then there exist a finite type $D$-algebra $D'$, a factorization $D\to D'\to A$, and $F'\in D(\mathcal O_{X_{D'}})$ with bounded coherent cohomology, together with $\gamma':F'\to R\pi'_*K$, where $\pi':X_A\to X_{D'}$. Put $q':X_{D'}\to\operatorname{Spec}D'$ and $M'=\widetilde A[0]$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. Define
$$\theta':Lq'^*M'\otimes^{\mathbf L}F'\longrightarrow R\pi'_*K$$
by adjunction [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] from the scalar action and the transpose of $\gamma'$:
$$L\pi'^*(Lq'^*M'\otimes^{\mathbf L}F')\simeq L(q'\pi')^*M'\otimes^{\mathbf L}L\pi'^*F'\longrightarrow\mathcal O_{X_A}\otimes^{\mathbf L}K\simeq K.$$
Derived pullback and tensor are [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. The cone of $\theta'$ has quasi-coherent cohomology and $H^i=0$ for every $i\geq n$. No ring map is assumed flat. No relative pseudo-coherence of $K$, map relating $F$ to $F'$, or conclusion below $n$ is assumed or asserted. The assertion includes the empty scheme and empty cover.

source.place: Agent-formulated global one-degree obstruction-cancellation prerequisite for the unnumbered Kiehl assertion after Tag 0CSD, lemma-flat-proper-pseudo-coherent-direct-image-general. Not a theorem stated in that paragraph. Kiehl (1972), Ein Descente-Lemma und Grothendiecks Projektionssatz fuer nichtnoethersche Schemata, Math. Ann. 198, pp.287--316, primary descente source WANTED.

proof.text: Each $S_j$ is Noetherian, being a finite type algebra over $D$. On $T_j$, coherence and the affine finite-type section criterion imply that the cohomology modules of $L_j$ are finitely generated over $S_j$; their nonzero degrees lie in the fixed finite cohomology interval of $F$. Apply the affine single-degree cancellation node to $(D,A,S_j,Q_j,K_j,L_j,\gamma_j,n)$. Its polynomial cone is exactly $C_j$ in the hypothesis. Obtain $D\to E_j\to A$, with $E_j$ finite type over $D$, and $G_j\in D(S_j\otimes_D E_j)$ with bounded finitely generated cohomology and a map $\delta_j$ to the restriction of $K_j$. The cone of its normalized map $A\otimes_{E_j}^{\mathbf L}G_j\to K_j$ has zero cohomology in all degrees $i\ge n$.

source.place: Agent-formulated one-degree Mayer--Vietoris improvement with a supplied global coherent witness, a prerequisite below the unnumbered Kiehl assertion after Tag 0CSD, lemma-flat-proper-pseudo-coherent-direct-image-general. The Stacks paragraph does not state this assertion. Kiehl (1972), Ein Descente-Lemma und Grothendiecks Projektionssatz fuer nichtnoethersche Schemata, Math. Ann. 198, pp.287--316, primary descente proof WANTED.

proof.text: The rings $E_j$ and $S_j\otimes_D E_j$ are Noetherian by finite-type permanence. Under the affine derived equivalence, $G_j$ therefore defines a bounded coherent object on $(T_j)_{E_j}$: on a Noetherian affine scheme finite module cohomology corresponds to coherent cohomology. The affine pushforward resolution comparison identifies the target of $\delta_j$ with the restriction of $R\pi_{j*}(K|_{(T_j)_A})$, so $\delta_j$ gives a sheaf-derived map to this target. The affine pullback and tensor comparisons identify $Lq_j^*\widetilde A\otimes^{\mathbf L}\widetilde{G_j}$ with the sheafification of $A\otimes_{E_j}^{\mathbf L}G_j$. To check the map, take a K-flat resolution $P\to A$ over $E_j$. Both transposes use $P\to A$ followed by the given scalar multiplication on $K_j$ and the transpose of $\delta_j$: on pure tensors the action is $a\otimes k\mapsto ak$. Thus derived adjunction identifies the sheaf map with the normalized map of step 1. The affine equivalence carries its cone to a quasi-coherent cone with the same cohomology vanishing. This proves $\mathcal A_n(T_j)$ as defined in the global-witness one-degree patching node.

source.place: Agent-formulated one-degree Mayer--Vietoris improvement with a supplied global coherent witness, a prerequisite below the unnumbered Kiehl assertion after Tag 0CSD, lemma-flat-proper-pseudo-coherent-direct-image-general. Ann. 198, pp.287--316, primary descente proof WANTED.

proof.text: Retain the supplied global $F,\gamma$. Define $\theta_0:Lq^*\widetilde A\otimes^{\mathbf L}F\to R\pi_*K$ by the same adjunction normalization as in the statement, at coefficient stage $D$. On $T_j$ its source is $(S_j\otimes_D^{\mathbf L}A)\otimes_{S_j}^{\mathbf L}L_j\simeq A\otimes_D^{\mathbf L}L_j$, by the affine pullback/tensor formulas. This, after restriction to $Q_j$, equals $Q_{j,A}\otimes_{Q_j}^{\mathbf L}L_j$: $Q_j$ is free over $D$ on monomials. Indeed, a K-flat $Q_j$-resolution $P$ is K-flat over $D$, since for acyclic $N$ the complex $N\otimes_D Q_j$ is a direct sum of copies of $N$, and $(N\otimes_D Q_j)\otimes_{Q_j}P$ is acyclic by K-flatness. The equality $Q_{j,A}\otimes_{Q_j}P=A\otimes_D P$ gives the comparison. The same calculation applies to the target action map. Both maps apply $\gamma_j$ then the augmentation and $A$-multiplication, so adjunction identifies the restricted $\theta_0$ with the map defining $C_j$, after forgetting scalars to $Q_j$. Thus its cone restricts to the underlying cone $C_j$ on every chart. The affine equivalence gives quasi-coherent cohomology there, and $H^i=0$ for $i>n$; these local statements hold globally. Consequently the original $(D,F,\gamma)$ is the required global witness at cutoff $n+1$.

proof.text: Set $W_k=T_1\cup\cdots\cup T_k$. Prove $\mathcal A_n(W_k)$ by induction, keeping $D,A,K,n$ fixed. Step 2 proves the base $k=1$. For $k>1$ use the two opens $W_{k-1},T_k$ of $W_k$. They are quasi-compact, being finite unions of affine opens; their union is separated finite type over $D$, since the diagonal restricts from that of $X$ and local finite type restricts to opens. Crucially, supply the new patching lemma with $F|_{W_k}$ and the restriction of the original $\gamma$, at the original coefficient stage $D$. Its normalized cone is quasi-coherent and vanishes for $i\ge n+1$ by step 3. The affine formulas commute with open restriction; the affine pushforward comparison computes pushforward termwise, and ordinary pushforward commutes with the open restriction. These comparisons preserve the action map by its adjunction description. The induction witness on $W_{k-1}$ and step 2 on $T_k$ supply the two cutoff-$n$ premises. The global-witness one-degree binary patching lemma now gives $\mathcal A_n(W_k)$. At $k=r$, expand this predicate to obtain precisely the required $D',F',\gamma',\theta'$.

proof.text: If $r=0$, the stipulated cover forces $X=\varnothing$. Take $D'=D$, $F'=0$ and $\gamma'=0$; all structure-module sheaves on the empty scheme vanish, so the source, target and cone of $\theta'$ vanish. This also covers the empty base ring and empty base changes. For $r>0$ zero or redundant charts do not change the preceding induction.
